name: gizza-ai/tar-archive
summary: Bundle multiple files into a single .tar (or .tar.gz) archive.

tool.description: Bundle multiple files into a single downloadable .tar archive, optionally compressed to .tar.gz (gzip), .tar.bz2 (bzip2) or .tar.xz (xz). Provide at least one file; each is a URL or a `ref` to an uploaded attachment. Entry names come from each file's name; duplicate names are made unique. Set `compression` to choose the format (default none = plain .tar).

files.description: Ordered list of files to bundle. Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`. Entry names come from each file's name; duplicates are made unique.

url.description: URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

compression.description: How to compress the whole archive. 'none' (default) is a plain `.tar`; 'gzip' makes `.tar.gz`; 'bzip2' makes `.tar.bz2` (smaller on text, slower); 'xz' makes `.tar.xz` (smallest, slowest).
